requirements.quote:
Ack-eliciting frames:  All frames other than ACK, PADDING, and
      CONNECTION_CLOSE are considered ack-eliciting.
requirements.condition: A frame is an ACK, PADDING, or CONNECTION_CLOSE frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the frame as not ack-eliciting.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify an ACK, PADDING, or CONNECTION_CLOSE frame as ack-eliciting.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply each enumerated frame type and inspect the implementation's ack-eliciting classification.

requirements.quote:
Ack-eliciting frames:  All frames other than ACK, PADDING, and
      CONNECTION_CLOSE are considered ack-eliciting.
requirements.condition: A frame has a type other than ACK, PADDING, or CONNECTION_CLOSE.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify any other frame type as non-ack-eliciting.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can supply any non-exempt frame type and inspect the resulting ack-eliciting classification.

requirements.quote:
Ack-eliciting packets:  Packets that contain ack-eliciting frames
      elicit an ACK from the receiver within the maximum acknowledgment
      delay and are called ack-eliciting packets.
requirements.condition: A packet contains at least one ack-eliciting frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as an ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify such a packet as non-ack-eliciting.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can construct a packet containing an ack-eliciting frame and inspect the packet classification.

requirements.quote:
Ack-eliciting packets:  Packets that contain ack-eliciting frames
      elicit an ACK from the receiver within the maximum acknowledgment
      delay and are called ack-eliciting packets.
requirements.condition: The receiver receives a packet containing at least one ack-eliciting frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Cause an ACK to be sent no later than the maximum acknowledgment delay.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not leave the packet unacknowledged beyond the maximum acknowledgment delay.
requirements.why_checkable: A timed runtime test can deliver an ack-eliciting packet and verify that an ACK is emitted within the configured maximum acknowledgment delay.

requirements.quote:
Ack-eliciting packets:  Packets that contain ack-eliciting frames
      elicit an ACK from the receiver within the maximum acknowledgment
      delay and are called ack-eliciting packets.
requirements.condition: A packet contains no ack-eliciting frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as not ack-eliciting.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not classify a packet without any ack-eliciting frame as an ack-eliciting packet.
requirements.why_checkable: The definition makes containment of an ack-eliciting frame the packet-classification criterion, so a test can construct an ACK/PADDING/CONNECTION_CLOSE-only packet and inspect the classification.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A packet is ack-eliciting or contains a PADDING frame, has been sent, and has not been acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with old keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not exclude the packet from the in-flight set while all of these conditions hold.
requirements.why_checkable: A stateful test can send a qualifying packet, withhold every listed terminal event, and inspect whether it remains in flight.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A packet is neither ack-eliciting nor contains a PADDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as not in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not count a packet as in flight solely because it has been sent and has no terminal disposition.
requirements.why_checkable: The definition restricts in-flight status to ack-eliciting packets or packets containing PADDING, which can be tested with an ACK-only or CONNECTION_CLOSE-only packet.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A qualifying ack-eliciting or PADDING-containing packet has not yet been sent.
requirements.required_behavior: Classify the packet as not in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not count an unsent packet as in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can create but not send a qualifying packet and inspect congestion-control or recovery state for in-flight accounting.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A sent packet that was in flight is acknowledged.
requirements.required_behavior: Remove the packet from in-flight classification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue to consider the acknowledged packet in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: A stateful test can acknowledge a tracked in-flight packet and verify that in-flight accounting no longer includes it.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A sent packet that was in flight is declared lost.
requirements.required_behavior: Remove the packet from in-flight classification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue to consider the lost packet in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: A stateful test can trigger loss declaration for a tracked packet and verify that in-flight accounting no longer includes it.

requirements.quote:
In-flight packets:  Packets are considered in flight when they are
      ack-eliciting or contain a PADDING frame, and they have been sent
      but are not acknowledged, declared lost, or discarded along with
      old keys.
requirements.condition: A sent packet that was in flight is discarded along with old keys.
requirements.required_behavior: Remove the packet from in-flight classification.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Do not continue to consider the discarded packet in flight.
requirements.why_checkable: A stateful test can discard old keys and the associated tracked packet, then verify that in-flight accounting no longer includes that packet.
